column1: adjust_session,"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.adjust_session(p_booking_id uuid, p_duration integer, p_price integer)
if p_duration is null or p_duration < 15 or p_duration > 240
or p_price is null or p_price < 0 or p_price > 100000 then return 'bad_input'
select * into b from bookings where id = p_booking_id and kind = 'booking' for update
if p_duration = b.duration and p_price = b.price then return 'no_change'
/* therapist already booked in the new window? */
if b.therapist_id is not null and exists (
where x.id <> b.id and x.therapist_id = b.therapist_id and x.date = b.date
and x.start_min < new_end and x.end_min > b.start_min) then
/* room already booked in the new window? */
if b.room_no is not null and exists (
where x.id <> b.id and x.loc_id = b.loc_id and x.date = b.date and x.room_no = b.room_no
and x.start_min < new_end and x.end_min > b.start_min) then
/* centre capacity, only matters when extending */
select count(*) into n from bookings x
where x.id <> b.id and x.loc_id = b.loc_id and x.date = b.date
and x.start_min < new_end and x.end_min > b.start_min
assign_room,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_room(p_booking_id uuid, p_room integer)
select * into b from bookings where id = p_booking_id and kind = 'booking'
update bookings set room_no = null where id = p_booking_id
if p_room < 1 or p_room > room_cap(b.loc_id) then return 'no_such_room'
update bookings set room_no = p_room where id = p_booking_id

confirm_booking,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_booking(p_token text, p_ref text, p_loc_name text, p_service_id text, p_service_name text, p_price integer, p_name text, p_phone text, p_notes text, p_source text DEFAULT 'online'::text, p_created_by text DEFAULT NULL::text)
if p_name is null or length(trim(p_name)) < 2 then return 'badname'
if p_price < 0 or p_price > 50000              then return 'badprice'
where token = p_token and kind = 'hold' and expires_at > now()
return case when hit = 1 then 'ok' else 'expired' end
create_hold,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_hold(p_loc text, p_date date, p_start integer, p_duration integer, p_rooms integer, p_token text)
if p_duration not in (50, 60, 80, 90) then return 'invalid'
if p_start < 690 or (p_start + p_duration) > 1380 then return 'closed'
if p_date < current_date or p_date > current_date + 30 then return 'baddate'
if p_rooms < 1 or p_rooms > 30 then return 'invalid'
delete from bookings where kind = 'hold' and expires_at < now()
insert into bookings(kind, loc_id, date, start_min, end_min,
values('hold', p_loc, p_date, p_start, p_start + p_duration,
p_duration, n, p_token, now() + interval '7 minutes')
